## What it is

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Uncover Picasso's sexier side with samples of the artist's raunchier works inspired by the female form, and admire reproductions of some of history's more graphic works – from _shunga_ to classical pieces by Goya and Velázquez.
>
> From classical to kinky, find out more about sadomasochism and bondage, and see the 'Chair of Pleasure' with its shackles and accessories. Alongside exhibitions and art, there are also tons of fascinating facts about some of the world's sexual record breakers.
